$comment: Person signals (issue 45, decisions D-signals-1 to D-signals-5). A signal is a colored flag on a profile that asks staff to act, and Rock's Top Person Signal badge shows the person's top open one. 'types' are the church's signal types, in the order Rock's signal type editor gives them (each new type one after the last), so the first is the top signal when a person has several. Each type's 'security' is what Rock's security editor saves: each allowed role in order, then deny All Users. View shows a signal's note and end date, and Edit lets a person add the type. 'cast' are the Cast's own signals, by Cast Guid: the owner is the staff member who follows up, 'addedBy' is who added it when that is someone else, and a signal ends 'endsInDays' after install day, ended 'endedDaysAgo' before it, or never. 'crowd' gives each campus with generated households Care Team Follow-ups owned by its campus pastor, for adults in the listed connection statuses, at most one per household: some still open and the rest ended, with notes from its list. 'access' are questions verify asks Rock's own security check. Notes stay general and factual, and nothing reads as an accusation.
